mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.05% for three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, thereby generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
